name: 78028 · Kerrville, TX
findings: ZIP 78028 (Kerrville) has 214 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 60 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78028 (Kerrville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 78028 (Kerrville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
